## Relationship Set (RS)

`containsMany` of typed relations (duplicate-of / caused-by / blocks / blocked-by / related-to / follows-up) with target id+title, note and attribution. The type is data; nothing names a domain.

### Non-goals

Not bidirectional bookkeeping — the inverse edge is derived by query, never mirrored by hand. `containsMany`-of-links cannot be JSON-patched: writers mutate + SaveCard.
